method: Real combat engine and real repeated champion armies at exactly equal recursively expanded rank-weight commitment. The least common multiple sets integer copy counts; both armies use the same nearest-first integer tile plan with no overlaps. The same actual paid support recipes are added to both budgets when enabled. Nine scenarios, 20 s, 0.05 s steps, seed 91731, finite 50,000-HP targets (500,000 HP bosses) replaced on the next frame.
limitations: These armies are controlled fixtures, not a claim that a player acquired dozens of the same Advanced champion.
Target replacement has a one-frame delay; extreme bursts can waste overkill and are assessed with kills, control and recovery as well as effective HP damage.
Different copy counts and real attack reaches affect route exposure; the exact common placement rule and formations are retained.
Rank-weight commitment is not acquisition probability, and these results do not certify TOP progression or 50-wave win-rate parity.
